source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    foregrounds = set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background)
    for color in foregrounds:
        full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == color for v in grid[r])]
        if not full_rows:
            continue
        for r, row in enumerate(grid):
            if row[0] != color or all(v == color for v in row):
                continue
            end = 0
            while end < w and row[end] == color:
                end += 1
            if end < w and all(v == background for v in row[end:]):
                out[r][end] = 1
    return out
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    for dr in range(h):
        for sr in range(h):
            if sr == dr:
                continue
            src, dst = grid[sr], grid[dr]
            missing = [c for c in range(w) if src[c] != bg and dst[c] == bg]
            if not missing or not any(src[c] == dst[c] and src[c] != bg for c in range(w)):
                continue
            if any(dst[c] != bg and dst[c] != src[c] for c in range(w)):
                continue
            for c in missing:
                out[dr][c] = 1
    return out
'''
